caption: This is a monochromatic line drawing on a beige or off-white background, depicting technical sketches of a table. The drawing features three main views: a top view, a front elevation view, and a side view. The top view, located in the upper left portion, shows a table with a rectangular shape and rounded, scalloped corners, along with dashed lines indicating dimensions. Below the top view is the front elevation, displaying four straight, turned legs, a single drawer with a round knob at the center, and the tabletop whose shape corresponds to the top view. To the right of the front elevation, there is a side view of the table, showcasing one flat edge and one half-round edge, with measurements similarly marked. The lines are fine and precise, emphasizing the measured and proportional nature of the drawing, and there are no additional colors or shading present. The technical illustration is contained within a neatly drawn rectangular border, and dimensions are labeled along the edges of each view.
title: Oval Table Drop Leaf
